purpose: Separate bounded optimization progress, independent demonstration coverage, and mature native-vision versus RAW task readability
frozen_raw: same RAW850 spatial-only backbone and multiscale fusion as r14; exact existing98 cached token rows reused
data_selection: existing3 Normal train episodes; more adds all remaining Normal train groups excluding the existing reserved Normal validation episode18
validation: same episode18,11 windows; never optimizer input
test: same5 historical dev episodes55 windows; actual light coverage Normal and Over only; primary comparison Normal
head_architecture: identical SmallActionHead,3x16x16x2048 visual slots,per-token bottleneck8,hidden256,full50x32 output; identical seed-specific initial tensors
state_only: visual slots zero during both fitting and evaluation; same nominal parameters; absent visual information implies different effective degrees of freedom
head_objective: masked normalized native32 direct action MSE; controls leading14; no clipping
pi_scope: same frozen RAW850 representation, inherited q/v LoRA rank8, fresh identity residual adapter128; original pi frozen; native32 masked flow loss; no new trainable modules
initialization: fresh controlled readout optimizer/cursor; pi RAW850 weights as before; explicit RNG reset after loading parent; not r14 optimizer resume
sampling: uniform without replacement within each batch8 over declared anchors; same exact order across modalities per seed and demo count; data counts change examples per epoch at fixed updates
selection: lowest primary validation normalized14 action MSE among step0 and checkpoints seen within each budget; no test use until all1024 updates finish
pi_evaluation: native10-step flow solver; primary fixed noise seed for selection; two fixed noise seeds for final selected/last train/val/test metrics
native_reference: strict pretrained SigLIP plus official projector and PI0 image preprocessing; complete256 tokens/camera; independent official RGB original-lighting joint-action replay; no teacher/distillation
paired_rgb_checks: entire actions,measured robot state,left/right EE arrays and frame counts exact; frame-index lookup; original-light replay does not prove pixel/physics equivalence
interpretation_limits: 3vs5 is a small data increase; failure to improve cannot rule out data limitation
historical development data are not a new blind benchmark
native reference differs in pretraining and RGB acquisition; its advantage cannot uniquely identify RAW format or architecture
readout action fit is not a physical success criterion
pi one training seed; small heads two seeds do not establish statistical population claims
